PRT_base_shell.orient: upside down: deck face on the bed, walls up

PRT_base_floor.orient: flat, partition wall and bosses up (the v2 partition printed upright too: rear face was its bed)

PRT_pan_servo_mount.orient: plate top on the bed, pocket walls up

PRT_pan_pinion.orient: gear top on the bed, horn pocket up (the 8 pins grow up from its floor)

BUY_battery.src: components.json dewalt_20v_battery envelope; rail stem width estimated (BATT_STEM_INSET)

BUY_servo_controller.src: components.json; switch + terminal positions from REF/servo_controller_board_photo.png (CTRL_SW, CTRL_TB)

BUY_horn_pan.src: components.json servo_horn_disc (+ the servo output spline)

CAB_bus_pan.bom_item: Hiwonder 3-pin bus lead 350 (next stock length up from 300), one wire with CAB_bus_pan_tail; static side: base pocket, riser, arch and the U-loop, ending ON the pan axis at (0, 0, 63) (params BUS_PAN_AX), so the hand-over to the turning tail has zero chord at every pan

PRT_turntable.orient: bottom face on the bed, posts upright (tunnel roofs and the hub roof bridge <= 23 mm; servo pocket, idler slot and U-slots open to the top; release-slot roofs bridge 4.2)

PRT_hub_gear.orient: gear face on the bed, hub tube up (3 snap fingers and 3 dogs grow up; barb catch faces 0.5 ledges)

PRT_beam.orient: top face (feed floor, z 263) on the bed; spout, tongues and the 4 snap hooks grow up

BUY_horn_tilt.src: components.json servo_horn_disc (+ the servo output spline)

PRT_tilt_horn_adapter.orient: key end (-X) on the bed; 45 deg cone to the disc, horn pocket up, the 8 pins grow up from its floor

CAB_bus_tilt.bom_item: Hiwonder 3-pin bus lead 300; moving side, hub-end plug cut off, enters BUY_bus_junction (BOM 14a) at its top face (z 92) in the R14 hub-tube bore

CAB_bus_pan_tail.bom_item: the last 12.7 of the CAB_bus_pan 350 lead (no separate purchase; cable_chains 'pan bus lead' 350 covers both routes): turns with PIV_pan from the pan axis at z 63 up to the splice's bottom face centre (5.73, 4.02, 72); hub-end plug cut off, soldered into BUY_bus_junction at step 11a

BUY_bus_junction.src: 3 x 3-to-1 solder splices under heat shrink, sleeved (BOM 14a): servo bus V+/GND/signal of CAB_bus_pan, CAB_bus_tilt and CAB_bus_feeder; O10 x 20 envelope
BUY_bus_junction.bom_item: BOM 14a: 3-way Hiwonder bus star splice, 3 x 3-to-1 solder splices (like wires joined) each under heat shrink, the three sleeved together, 20 long or less; modelled as a O10 x 20 envelope on PIV_pan in the R14 hub-tube bore at r 7 az 35 (5.73, 4.02), z 72..92; 8 g; soldered below the deck (shell on its side, floor off) and pushed up the bore at step 11a; the turntable's printed bore roof (z 100) stops it rising

FST_nip_stud.bom_item: M3 x 16 hex head ISO 4017 (AF 5.5 x 2.0), modelled as cadlib M3_hex x 16; captive in the hood's hex pocket (three +v flats key it), never driven; FST_tw_nut is captive in the thumbwheel's side slot

PRT_nacelle.orient: front plate on the bed, journal up (duct roof bridges 15 mm)

PRT_launcher_body.orient: left (motor) wall outer face on the bed; profile extruded so every wall is vertical

PRT_journal_plate.orient: inner face on the bed; lap step, journal, socket and stop lug grow up

PRT_launcher_cover.orient: inner face on the bed; rebated edge steps in toward the top

PRT_hood.orient: on its side face (profile extruded, all walls vertical; stud pocket has a vertex up)

PRT_nip_wheel.orient: outer face on the bed; integral max-gap spigot up; the tw nut slides in through the radial side slot (0.5 skin over it)

PRT_nip_leaf.orient: flat: strip's outer face on the bed, root block and pads up (bending stress in the layer plane)

PRT_nip_cover.orient: +v end on the bed (v3: no screw block; dovetail tongue, skirt lip and detent arm); shell and end walls grow up as vertical walls; skirt bridges at the top; finger slot 22 x 8.3 in the -v end wall over the thumbwheel rim (v2-A1-02)

PRT_flywheel.orient: motor-side web face on the bed; rim and hub grow up (top flange has a 45 deg underside)
PRT_flywheel.notes: wrap 12-15 mm hockey tape on the 14 mm land. The 72 mm 'bridge' cadcheck reports is the 1 mm R36 flange ring over the rim's 45 deg underside (33 mm2 ceiling): it prints as perimeter loops on the cone, declared benign (v2-A1-08)

BUY_tape.src: BOM item 12: 1/2 in hockey tape, one wrap on the 14 mm land (TAPE_T 0.5)

PRT_encoder_cap.orient: back face on the bed, spigot and pegs up

CAB_encoder.bom_item: one-piece twisted 5-wire JST-SH encoder lead >= 550 (ENC_LEAD), Plink -> MotorGo encoder JST, unspliced; rides CAB_launcher_bundle (262.6) and CAB_launcher_base (156.1) on the far side of the sleeve from the 3 phases; Plink-to-journal share 126.3 for a 85.9 route

PRT_feeder_crown.orient: top plane (z 322: socket rim + closed lobe roof) on the bed; lip, socket cone, leg cones, pocket floors print as floors or 45-50 deg cones; the 3 snap hooks grow up

BUY_horn_feeder.src: components.json servo_horn_disc (+ the servo output spline)

PRT_feeder_pinion.orient: gear face on the bed, horn pocket up (the 8 pins grow up from its floor)

PRT_feeder_disc.orient: gear band on the bed, fins up

CAB_bus_feeder.bom_item: Hiwonder 3-pin bus lead 500; moving side, hub-end plug cut off, enters BUY_bus_junction (BOM 14a) at its top face (z 92) in the R14 hub-tube bore

BUY_jar.src: DESIGN_BRIEF v2 table (Ball/Kerr regular-mouth pint, nominal, confirm with calipers)

BUY_mm_fill.src: 400 g of M&Ms (mass carrier for the tip check)

PRT_jar_adapter.orient: lid disc (glass side) on the bed, spout up

PRT_jar_valve.orient: skirt + baffle bottom on the bed; lug undersides 50 deg, snap fingers and pads grow up

PRT_jar_gate.orient: flat, chamfer, tab and stop lug up; the detent finger bends in the layer plane
